rules: Use Typescript, Next.js, and Shadcn UI components.
Organize components into logical directories and keep them small and reusable.
Use React Query (TanStack Query) or SWR for asynchronous data fetching.
Define API routes in `app/api/` and handle API errors consistently.
Optimize images using `next/image` and consider lazy loading for non-critical components.
Write unit and integration tests for key components and logic.
